name: Comfyui-indextts25-xzg
author: xiaozhuguang
description: ComfyUI custom nodes for IndexTTS 2.5 - Zero-shot voice cloning with emotion control, multilingual support (ZH/EN/JA/ES/AR), and sampling configuration.

nodes.name: XZG_IndexTTS25_ModelLoader
nodes.display_name: IndexTTS 2.5 Model Loader | IndexTTS 2.5 模型加载器
nodes.author: xiaozhuguang
nodes.description: Discover and validate the IndexTTS 2.5 model under ComfyUI/models/TTS; weights are loaded on demand at first generation.

nodes.name: XZG_IndexTTS25_EmotionControl
nodes.display_name: IndexTTS 2.5 Emotion Control | IndexTTS 2.5 情感控制
nodes.author: xiaozhuguang
nodes.description: Control emotion in four ways: 8-dimensional vector, emotion reference audio, text description, or follow the voice.

nodes.name: XZG_IndexTTS25_SamplingConfig
nodes.display_name: IndexTTS 2.5 Sampling Config | IndexTTS 2.5 采样配置
nodes.author: xiaozhuguang
nodes.description: Centrally configure determinism, sampling, long-text segmentation, pauses and text normalization parameters.

nodes.name: XZG_IndexTTS25_Generate
nodes.display_name: IndexTTS 2.5 Speech Generation | IndexTTS 2.5 语音生成
nodes.author: xiaozhuguang
nodes.description: Multilingual zero-shot voice cloning with the IndexTTS 2.5 model, outputting standard ComfyUI AUDIO.
